files.name: arena.gno
gnomod.toml
files.body:
# arena/v1's module path, explained -- deploy status deliberately NOT recorded here, for
# the same reason hollowmere/v1/gnomod.toml gives: this file ships on chain exactly as
# written the moment arena/v1 is deployed, and a realm cannot be edited afterwards.
# garden/v2/gnomod.toml said "NOT deployed" in this same spot, was deployed, and now
# carries that false line permanently on chain. Whether and when this has been deployed
# lives in the repo root's DECISIONS.md and STATUS.md, both of which can still be edited
# after the fact, unlike this file.
#
# The module path mirrors garden/garden.gno, garden/v2/garden.gno and hollowmere/v1's own
# placeholder style: the deploy key's own address namespace, not a name, because
# `gnotchi` is not registerable today (r/sys/names, team-held controller -- see
# realms/garden/NOTES.md). Whoever deploys this should re-check this path is still right
# first, and MUST deploy garden/v2 (if not already live) before this realm, since arena.gno
# imports it directly by this exact path and reads GnomeByAddress from it.
module = "gno.land/r/g1r4aw43kagaaquhegxw6xr346h9f2qu2ezf0jar/arena/v1"
gno = "0.9"
